items.a1: SevenCMS is an open-source multilingual content management system built with Angular 20, NestJS 11, and MongoDB.
items.a2: Out of the box: English, Russian, Georgian, Ukrainian, Azerbaijani, Armenian, Belarusian, German and French.
items.a3: The admin panel is fully responsive and works on mobile browsers. A native app is not currently on the roadmap.
items.a4: See the Support page for contact options and response times.
